##########################################################################
# Eire Reborn - Update 3 on_actions (generated by tools/gen_script_conq.py)
# Hooked into random_yearly_playable_pulse and the war-result lists in eir_on_actions.txt
##########################################################################

eir_conqueror_pulse_1 = {
	trigger = {
		current_year >= 900
		NOT = { has_global_variable = eir_conq_done_1 }
		eir_conq_ready_trigger = yes
	}
	random_events = {
		chance_to_happen = 10
		1 = eir.0610
	}
}

eir_conqueror_pulse_2 = {
	trigger = {
		current_year >= 950
		NOT = { has_global_variable = eir_conq_done_2 }
		has_global_variable = eir_conq_done_1
		eir_conq_ready_trigger = yes
	}
	random_events = {
		chance_to_happen = 10
		1 = eir.0620
	}
}

eir_conqueror_pulse_3 = {
	trigger = {
		current_year >= 1000
		NOT = { has_global_variable = eir_conq_done_3 }
		has_global_variable = eir_conq_done_2
		eir_conq_ready_trigger = yes
	}
	random_events = {
		chance_to_happen = 10
		1 = eir.0630
	}
}

eir_conqueror_pulse_4 = {
	trigger = {
		current_year >= 1050
		NOT = { has_global_variable = eir_conq_done_4 }
		has_global_variable = eir_conq_done_3
		eir_conq_ready_trigger = yes
	}
	random_events = {
		chance_to_happen = 10
		1 = eir.0640
	}
}

eir_conqueror_pulse_5 = {
	trigger = {
		current_year >= 1100
		NOT = { has_global_variable = eir_conq_done_5 }
		has_global_variable = eir_conq_done_4
		eir_conq_ready_trigger = yes
	}
	random_events = {
		chance_to_happen = 10
		1 = eir.0650
	}
}

eir_war_won_attacker_conq = {
	effect = {
		scope:attacker = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = eir_conq_id }
				save_scope_as = eir_conqueror
				var:eir_conq_title ?= { save_scope_as = eir_conq_title }
				scope:defender = {
					if = {
						limit = { is_ai = no }
						save_scope_as = eir_conq_player
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = {
							exists = top_liege
							top_liege = { is_ai = no }
						}
						top_liege = { save_scope_as = eir_conq_player }
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { exists = scope:eir_conq_player }
					scope:eir_conq_player = {
						if = {
							limit = { scope:eir_conqueror.var:eir_conq_id = 1 }
							trigger_event = eir.0612
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { scope:eir_conqueror.var:eir_conq_id = 2 }
							trigger_event = eir.0622
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { scope:eir_conqueror.var:eir_conq_id = 3 }
							trigger_event = eir.0632
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { scope:eir_conqueror.var:eir_conq_id = 4 }
							trigger_event = eir.0642
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { scope:eir_conqueror.var:eir_conq_id = 5 }
							trigger_event = eir.0652
						}
					}
				}
				else = {
					eir_conq_clear_effect = yes
				}
				remove_variable = eir_conq_id
				remove_variable = eir_conq_title
			}
		}
	}
}


eir_war_won_defender_conq = {
	effect = {
		scope:attacker = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = eir_conq_id }
				save_scope_as = eir_conqueror
				var:eir_conq_title ?= { save_scope_as = eir_conq_title }
				scope:defender = {
					if = {
						limit = { is_ai = no }

					}
					else_if = {
						limit = {
							exists = top_liege
							top_liege = { is_ai = no }
						}
						top_liege = { save_scope_as = eir_conq_player }
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { exists = scope:eir_conq_player }

						if = {
							limit = { scope:eir_conqueror.var:eir_conq_id = 1 }
							trigger_event = eir.0611
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { scope:eir_conqueror.var:eir_conq_id = 2 }
							trigger_event = eir.0621
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { scope:eir_conqueror.var:eir_conq_id = 3 }
							trigger_event = eir.0631
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { scope:eir_conqueror.var:eir_conq_id = 4 }
							trigger_event = eir.0641
						}
						else_if = {
							limit = { scope:eir_conqueror.var:eir_conq_id = 5 }
							trigger_event = eir.0651

					}
				}
				else = {

				}
				remove_variable = eir_conq_id
				remove_variable = eir_conq_title
			}
		}
